findings.summary: The sentence naming what the project is designed to do lost its cleft, putting Providence in the subject position the paragraph avoids.

evidence.baseline: What Providence is being designed to do, at its current early stage, is operate at the layer above this design space.
evidence.shipped: At its current early stage, Providence is being designed to operate at the layer above this design space.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.9 read onto the cleft, and compression.
findings.diagnosis: The cleft delays the predicate so the reader holds the question what is it designed to do before receiving a deliberately modest answer. It also keeps the design in the subject position rather than the project, which is the discipline this whole section is performing. The same operation was applied to the same construction in Providence and Artificial Intelligence, so it is a habit rather than a local judgment.

findings.summary: Four qualifiers bounding the physiological-wallet description were removed.

evidence.baseline: or that they will be solved through Providence's particular architecture ... Over enough utilization, that layer is intended to support ... Anyone reading this book and inferring that Providence has already solved those problems ... The bet is that ... simply helping aligned people find one another
evidence.shipped: or that Providence's particular architecture will solve them ... With sufficient use, that layer is intended to support ... Anyone who infers that Providence has already solved those problems ... The bet is that ... helping aligned people find one another

findings.diagnosis: Solved through the architecture makes the architecture a means; the architecture will solve them makes it an agent, which is the reverse of the disclaimer's direction. Over enough utilization is vaguer than with sufficient use and deliberately so, since no threshold is known. Anyone reading this book and inferring locates the misreading in this text, which is the sentence's whole purpose as a warning to the present reader. And simply is the word that makes the bet modest: the claim is that something small produces value, not that helping people is valuable.

findings.summary: The closing discipline was folded from four imperatives after a full stop into a colon list.

evidence.baseline: This is the discipline the project intends to hold. Begin with what is genuinely useful and reasonably safe. Build the trust architecture ... Refuse to scale faster ... And remain willing, at every stage, to walk away from any design choice ...
evidence.shipped: This is the discipline the project intends to hold: begin with what is genuinely useful and reasonably safe. Build the trust architecture ... Refuse to scale faster ... Remain willing, at every stage, to walk away ...

findings.diagnosis: The full stop makes the four imperatives free-standing commitments rather than items specified by the sentence before them. The colon subordinates the first to the frame and leaves the other three orphaned, which is grammatically odd as well as weaker. And before the fourth marks it as the last and hardest, which is the standard polysyndetic close this volume uses at the end of a series of commitments.

findings.summary: The research-question paragraph lost its frame and its reason.

evidence.baseline: The question of whether physiological signal could eventually contribute ... is a research question rather than a product commitment. The reason it is worth raising in this book is not that Providence has answered it, but that it is one of the genuinely important design questions of the coming century, and serious people should be working on it openly rather than allowing it to be resolved by default through whatever surveillance-capital actor reaches it first.
evidence.shipped: Whether physiological signal could eventually contribute ... is a research question rather than a product commitment. The question matters not because Providence has answered it, but because it is one of the important design questions of the coming century. Serious people should work on it openly rather than allow it to be resolved by default through whichever surveillance-capital actor reaches it first.

findings.diagnosis: The reason it is worth raising in this book is the narrator justifying an editorial choice, which is the register the voice card calls candid project accounting. The question matters is a claim about the question. Genuinely important also carries the concession that most design questions are not. And splitting the final clause into its own sentence turns a subordinate consequence into an instruction to the reader, which the corpus card's invitation rule resists.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. This section and Providence and Artificial Intelligence both lost the same cleft construction, What Providence is being designed to do and What it is paying attention to, and in both cases the replacement put the project in the subject position of a sentence written specifically to keep it out. That is now a named habit rather than two coincidences, and it is worth checking in the three remaining Providence disclosure sections.
